# Vault of Loci

> An Obsidian vault template for studying courses with AI agents: courses, lessons, concept notes, verified references, flashcards and automatic checks. Rules for agents are in AGENTS.md.

## Start here
- [README.md](README.md): what it is and how to start
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): structure, frontmatter, writing rules, safety
- [How_to_Study_with_this_Vault.md](How_to_Study_with_this_Vault.md): the study method
- [00_Home.md](00_Home.md): dashboard

## Examples
- [Retrieval practice](20_Concepts/Retrieval_Practice.md): a concept note with the full study layer
- [Test-enhanced learning](40_References/Papers/Test-Enhanced_Learning_(Roediger_and_Karpicke,_2006).md): a verified paper note
- [Example course](10_Courses/01_Example_Course/Example_Course.md): a course with one lesson

- [Studying with AI](40_References/Guides/Studying_with_AI.md): evidence and protocol
